full_text: Our inlaid puzzle box was forged in metal by Seth Gould.

formatting.caption: Our inlaid puzzle box was forged in metal by Seth Gould.

images.description: Japanese-style puzzle box made of brass/gold metal with intricate inlaid geometric patterns. Multiple patterns visible: interlocking circles (top), hexagonal honeycomb pattern (front), quatrefoil/flower pattern (sides), star burst pattern (right side). Box sits on small feet. Cream/white inlay contrasts with gold/brass metal.

key_elements: Multiple distinct patterns on each face
